Android\'s own call accessibility settings: RTT visibility and TTY mode

RTT sends text letter by letter during a call, so you can type and read instead of (or as well as) talking. It works only where your carrier supports it, mostly on 4G and Wi-Fi calling in the US, and the other phone has to support it too. Where it isn\'t offered, Parley doesn\'t show it. Switch to RTT any time from More in a call.
None of your SIMs offers RTT right now. Your carrier may not support it, or it may be off in Android\'s TTY and RTT settings.
